**Data Engineer, Logistics Startup**

We're a logistics startup looking for a Data Engineer. The pipelines you build will help get packages where they need to go, on time and on budget.

We just closed a $12M Series A. There are 60 of us, and you'll have a real, visible impact from day one. There's no red tape and no waiting around. You'll have the autonomy to build your ideas.

You'll work with dbt, Snowflake, and Airflow to design scalable pipelines, sharpen data models, and help teams across the company act with confidence on their data.

We offer 4 days of remote work each week, so you get the flexibility to do your best work while still having the collaboration you enjoy.

If you like solving complex problems and want your work to move things in the real world, we'd like to hear from you.
